question: Should this PR merge with the expected one-time safe thread replacement for existing beta plugin-state rows that still contain raw fingerprints?
rationale: The implementation is correct and legacy sidecars are normalized, but already-imported beta plugin-state rows can compare unequal once after upgrade; accepting that session transition is a maintainer merge-risk choice.

options.title: Accept the bounded transition
options.body: Merge the fix and accept one safe replacement thread for affected existing beta bindings while all future and migrated fingerprints remain bounded.

options.title: Require explicit plugin-state upgrade coverage
options.body: Add a test that seeds an existing raw plugin-state row and proves replacement preserves the OpenClaw session association before merge.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded transition
recommendation.body: Merge the fix and accept one safe replacement thread for affected existing beta bindings while all future and migrated fingerprints remain bounded.

likelyOwner.reason: The file history ties steipete most strongly to the binding lifecycle and fingerprint behavior whose upgrade semantics require acceptance.
